_comment: Step 6. Emotion types are content. bands: intensity 1-3 slight, 4-6 strong, 7-8 intense, 9-10 overwhelming. 'body' is what the citizen feels (second person, no numbers); 'cue' is what others see ({Name} {subj} {obj} {poss}, optional ' {at}' = ', glaring at Kael'). halfLifeHours is game hours. contagion: rate per 10 game minutes (0 = not contagious).

body: There's a lightness in you
You feel warm and light, and you keep wanting to smile
Your chest is full and you can hardly keep still
You are giddy, almost dizzy with happiness
cue: {Name} is beaming and can hardly keep still

body: A slight heaviness sits on you
There is a weight on your chest and your thoughts keep sinking
Your throat is tight and your eyes sting
Grief presses on you so hard it is difficult to breathe
cue: {Name}'s eyes are red and {subj} hardly looks up

body: A slight unease prickles at the back of your neck
Your stomach is tight and your hands are cold
Your heart is hammering and your mouth is dry
Terror has hold of you; your legs want to run on their own
cue: {Name} is white as chalk and shaking

body: A slight irritation itches at you
Your jaw is tight and there is heat in your face
Your jaw is clenched, your face is hot and your hands want to make fists
You are shaking with rage; everything else has gone red and far away
You feel a slight distaste
Your lip wants to curl and you would rather not stand close
Your stomach turns
You can barely keep from retching
A slight embarrassment warms your ears
Your face burns and you want to look at the floor
You feel eyes on you and wish the ground would open
You can hardly lift your head; you want to disappear
cue: {Name} is red-faced and won't meet anyone's eye

body: Something nags faintly at your conscience
There is a knot in your stomach that won't loosen
Your conscience gnaws at you; you keep going over what you did
Guilt sits on you like a stone; you can think of nothing else
cue: {Name} seems troubled and avoids people's eyes
{Name} flinches when spoken to, as if expecting blame

body: You feel quietly pleased with yourself
You stand a little straighter
Your chest swells; you feel a head taller
You are bursting with pride
cue: {Name} stands a little straighter than usual
{Name} carries {obj}self like someone who has won

body: You feel a slight warmth
A warmth spreads through your chest
Your heart is full and you want to be near
Tenderness floods you
cue: {Name} can't keep the fondness off {poss} face{at}

body: You feel a little thankful
You feel warmly thankful
You are moved, and you want to give something back
You are overwhelmed with gratitude
cue: {Name} is close to tears with gratitude{at}

body: Something pricks at you faintly
There is a sour twist in your stomach
It eats at you; your eyes keep going back to it
Wanting burns in you so hard that you can taste it
cue: {Name} keeps looking{at} with a sour face

body: Something tightens in you, faintly
There's a tight knot in your stomach
Your chest is tight and hot and you can't look away
It claws at you; you can hardly think for it
cue: {Name} watches{at} with a face like thunder

low: Everything feels a little grey today.
Everything feels grey and heavy today.
high: The day feels full of possibilities.
tense: You are wound tight; small things set your teeth on edge.
mood.lowLasting: You've felt low for days now.
mood.highLasting: You've been in high spirits lately.

notes.leave_conversation: it would feel like backing down

anger.instruction: Your first impulse feels overwhelmingly right; second thoughts feel far away.

fear.instruction: Your heart is pounding. It's hard to think past the danger.

shame.instruction: You want nothing more than to be somewhere nobody is looking at you.

guilt.instruction: What you did will not leave you alone.

envy.instruction: You keep coming back to what they have and you don't.

sadness.instruction: Everything takes effort; part of you just wants to be left alone.

joy.instruction: You feel like sharing it with someone.
